headline: Recovered Session 72, then shipped all six ranked items and all three viable second-order innovations with direct 877/877 proof.

items.title: Hermetic verification and lazy first-decision boot
items.evidence: Validated noncanonical renderer outputs preserve tracked truth; History, Settings, exports, and epilogue hydrate on demand; boot is 697,424/710,000 bytes with zero lazy leaks and 67 modules reachable.

items.title: Seven-room progression truth
items.evidence: Global plus room-level composite verdicts, bounded multi-seed history, explicit incomplete samples, and Position Room Watch alerts prevent offsetting drift and silent auto-tuning.

items.title: Player-directed Broadcast Director and Final Reel
items.evidence: Pause, four speeds, key navigation, keyboard controls, exact progress, diagnostics, and a deterministic final reel use typed scoring receipts and canonical team IDs without resimulation.

items.title: Honest Trophy Road
items.evidence: The three nearest measurable objectives render in Overview/mobile; event-only achievements state the qualifying event and never fabricate percentages; unlocks immediately advance the path.

items.title: Architect's Cut and Decision Anthology
items.evidence: Weekly-plan, transaction, and archived draft receipts become a bounded season reckoning and cross-season archive with explicit missing-evidence and non-causal language.

items.title: Rendered-pixel authority closed four hidden defects
items.evidence: The 125-capture loop found two broadcast score joins, an empty Guide modal, and rival coaching stale controls; all were root-fixed and 24 corrected dark/light desktop/mobile states are hash-bound.

followUps.title: Fresh live-code audit
followUps.evidence: Session 73 Genius List is 0 open / 6 closed and innovation pack is 0 open / 3 shipped; re-measure before adding another balance or feature surface.

blockers.title: Launch authority remains HOLD
blockers.evidence: Delivered reply-capable email, SHA-bound founder approval, and authoritative lifecycle reconciliation remain independent unmet gates.

honestyLedger.title: A green product was not enough while audit state was stale
honestyLedger.evidence: The first aggregate correctly failed its Studio shard because six shipped audit rows were still open. The JSON sidecar, generated Markdown, Genius cache, and innovation pack were reconciled, then Studio 161/161 and aggregate 877/877 passed.

honestyLedger.title: Text is not score authority
honestyLedger.evidence: Pixel review exposed that summary prose and play text differ and team IDs are nested. Typed scoring plays and canonical nested identifiers replaced fragile text/shape joins.

honestyLedger.title: No launch or causal claim was manufactured
honestyLedger.evidence: Route health, a decision followed by a win, or one room sample never substitutes for email/approval/lifecycle proof, causal evidence, or multi-seed balance evidence.

diffStat.suite: Node 877/877; Playwright 40/40; responsive 125; visual QA 24; boot 697,424/710,000; 67 modules; Pages build/smoke; Doctor blockingFailing 0; secret scan 0
